report_name: BlackNevas Ransomware Wipes VMware Estate Using Stolen Credentials

threat_actors.name: BlackNevas
threat_actors.description: A ransomware group that conducted a destructive attack against a VMware environment, using stolen credentials and legitimate administrative tools to wipe ESXi hosts, vCenter servers, and backups.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: The attackers used stolen valid account credentials to log into the vCenter Server Appliances for initial access.

attack_patterns.name: Disable or Modify Tools
attack_patterns.description: The attackers abused the vCenter Host Profiles feature to enable the SSH service across all targeted ESXi hosts, changing the security configuration to allow remote access.

attack_patterns.name: SSH
attack_patterns.description: With SSH enabled on the ESXi hosts, the attackers used SFTP to transfer their encryptor payload for lateral movement.

attack_patterns.name: Data Destruction
attack_patterns.description: The BlackNevas encryptor was executed to wipe four ESXi hosts, all associated VMs, the vCenter servers, and backup systems.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The BlackNevas ransomware payload was executed to encrypt and destroy data on the victim's VMware environment, including hosts, VMs, and backups.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: The attackers targeted and eliminated the backup infrastructure days before the main attack to prevent any possibility of restoration.

malware.name: BlackNevas Encryptor
malware.description: The ESXi encryptor payload deployed by the BlackNevas group to wipe ESXi hosts, virtual machines, and backups.

malware.name: MeshAgent
malware.description: Used by the BlackNevas group for command and control during the attack.

tools.name: Ligolo-ng
tools.description: Used by the BlackNevas group for network tunneling.

infrastructure.name: BlackNevas C2 Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: Command and control infrastructure used by the BlackNevas group, accessed via tools like MeshAgent and Ligolo-ng.

indicators.name: ESXi Firewall Modification via esxcli to Enable SSH
indicators.pattern:
title: ESXi Firewall Modification via esxcli to Enable SSH
id: 1a2b3c4d-5e6f-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of 'esxcli' to modify the ESXi firewall to enable the SSH server. This is a specific command used to bypass network restrictions for remote access, as seen in the BlackNevas attack.
references:
  - https://gbhackers.com/blacknevas-ransomware-attacks-vmware-esxi-servers/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-14
tags:
  - attack.t1562.001
  - attack.defense_evasion
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '/esxcli'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'network firewall ruleset set'
      - '-e true'
      - '-r SSH-Server'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the use of 'esxcli' to modify the ESXi firewall to enable the SSH server. This is a specific command used to bypass network restrictions for remote access.

indicators.name: Backup Service Process Termination
indicators.pattern:
title: Backup Service Process Termination
id: 3c4d5e6f-7a8b-4c9d-0e1f-2a3b4c5d6e7f
status: experimental
description: Detects the termination of common backup service processes, such as Veeam.Backup.Manager.exe. This is a common precursor to ransomware deployment, used by groups like BlackNevas to prevent recovery.
references:
  - https://gbhackers.com/blacknevas-ransomware-attacks-vmware-esxi-servers/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-11-14
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\taskkill.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\wmic.exe'
  selection_target:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Veeam.Backup.Manager.exe'
      - 'BackupExec.exe'
      - 'NetBackup.exe'
      - 'Arcserve.exe'
  condition: all of selection_*
indicators.description: Detects the termination of common backup service processes, such as Veeam.Backup.Manager.exe. This is a common precursor to ransomware deployment, used by groups like BlackNevas to prevent recovery.
